author: WPB7
summary: The manuscript's authoring guide: repository layout, batched build and verification policy, and the non-negotiable methodology. Layout, build cadence, commit and cross-reference rules are book process and historical. The evidence-grading rules (source-grounded claims, real screenshots, compilable examples) were already reflected in the site's evidence vocabulary; the example and screenshot rules were added to the compatibility-and-evidence deep dive.

concepts.text: The book is one LaTeX volume: chapters under latex/book/chapters/part{1-12}, appendices, front matter and main.tex, with a shared preamble whose \cnaclass/\cnans macros both typeset and index API names.
concepts.note: Manuscript layout; no CNA fact: a record of how the book was made, with no CNA behaviour to document.

concepts.text: The book was drafted as two volumes and merged into one on 2026-07-20; sessions start from NEXT.md, then PLAN.md, and PROGRESS.md is background only.
concepts.note: Session-handoff method of the book: a record of how the book was made, with no CNA behaviour to document.

concepts.text: Book builds are batched: write about 8 to 10 chapters, then run tools/verify-book.sh once, render every touched page to PNG and read it, fixing stale cross-references, overfull boxes and header collisions in one pass.
concepts.note: Author decision of 2026-07-21 about the manuscript's own verification cadence.

concepts.text: The sealed release command is not for in-progress manuscript changes, and every command that reads or writes the PDF must take the book-lock shared or exclusive lock keyed by the physical repository root.
concepts.note: Book artifact-locking protocol; no CNA fact.

concepts.section: Non-negotiable methodology (established across this whole project, not just the expansion)
concepts.text: Every claim is grounded in an actual read of a header, implementation, test or project document at the pinned revision, never paraphrased from memory; the project records its own corrections (for example an early 'no .xnb reader' claim that became false) rather than hiding them.
tokens: The site never claims to have run anything

target.evidence: deep-dives/foundations/compatibility-and-evidence.html (checked at 009d40f5): every deep dive carries a source-verified evidence box and says what was not executed

concepts.note: The site applies the same rule with its own vocabulary; the 'no .xnb reader' correction itself is historical (the XNB loader is documented on docs/content-pipeline-xnb.html).

concepts.section: Non-negotiable methodology (established across this whole project, not just the expansion)
concepts.text: Screenshots are real or absent: an image must never be a mock-up presented as a screenshot, and where a real capture is impossible for a renderer the text must say so instead of skipping the question.
tokens: a screenshot is evidence only for the revision
concepts.note: Stated on the site as a scoping rule: a screenshot is evidence only for the revision, renderer and host that produced it.

concepts.section: Non-negotiable methodology (established across this whole project, not just the expansion)
concepts.text: Code examples must be real, adapted from an actual CNA test or example call site where one exists, and never presented as verified when they were not compiled.
tokens: adapted from a compiled CNA test or example

target.evidence: deep-dives/foundations/compatibility-and-evidence.html (expanded by WPB7, checked at 009d40f5); README.md usage example read at 009d40f5

concepts.note: Added as the five example classes, with CNA's README usage example as the drift illustration (issue WPB7-i001).

concepts.section: Non-negotiable methodology (established across this whole project, not just the expansion)
concepts.text: While a writing batch is in flight a plan row must say it is pending verification and may only be relabelled 'PDF-verified clean' after the consolidated pass rendered and inspected its pages.
concepts.note: Status discipline for the book's own task rows.

concepts.section: Non-negotiable methodology (established across this whole project, not just the expansion)
concepts.text: Commit in small pushed increments, honour explicit author scope decisions (such as the free-direct page cap) and flag conflicts in PLAN.md instead of resolving them silently.
concepts.note: Book project management: a record of how the book was made, with no CNA behaviour to document.

concepts.section: Non-negotiable methodology (established across this whole project, not just the expansion)
concepts.text: Cross-chapter citations use \ref labels; plain 'Chapter~N' citations surviving from the two-volume era are the most common real failure after renumbering and must be grepped for.
concepts.note: LaTeX cross-reference hygiene of the book.
